message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime. Facts: In 2011, defendant Zhu Moujia applied to register a company (Taizhou Jinxiangyi Ecological Agriculture Development Co., Ltd). He lacked 5 million registration capital, so he commissioned Wang Mou to provide the capital, paying 3,000 yuan fee. Zhu used fraud to deceive the registration authority, obtained business license, then withdrew 5 million to repay Wang. So he committed fraud to obtain registration capital? This is likely "诈骗" (fraud) against the registration authority, i.e., fraud in business registration. Under Chinese criminal law, this is "诈骗罪" (fraud). Also possibly "非法经营" but not. The act: using false means to obtain registration capital from state? Actually the registration authority is a public organ; he deceived them to get a business license without real capital. That's fraud. So charge: 诈骗. No other crimes. He voluntarily surrendered and confessed, may get mitigation.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>. Need to output without "罪". So just "诈骗". JSON format with reasoning and final_answer.
